intended_object: The filtration indexed by ℕ on a countably generated measurable space α whose n-th σ-algebra is generated by the n-th finite partition `countablePartition α n`. This partition is built from the first n sets of a countable generating family. The description comes from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation:
The definition sets `seq n := generateFrom (countablePartition α n)`, which is exactly the σ-algebra generated by the n-th partition, as the docstring says. Monotonicity follows because each partition is refined by the next one. The bound by the ambient σ-algebra holds because every set in a partition is measurable. A companion lemma, `iSup_countableFiltration`, shows that the supremum of the filtration is the whole σ-algebra, which is the property the module needs.

This is a specific construction and needs the `CountablyGenerated` hypothesis, since the partitions come from the canonical countable generating set. The more general version for an arbitrary sequence of measurable sets, `partitionFiltration`, is defined just above it in the same file. So the definition is not too narrow, and it matches its description in every case.
